title: Rav Dimi son of Rav Huna of Damharya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Sanhedrin 29b and Menachot 81a, asking Ravina a question.[^1]

notes.text: Both saved Davidson passages have Rav Dimi, son of Rav Huna, addressing Ravina. Sanhedrin29b has מדמהריא and Menachot81a מדמהוריא; Hyman’s מדמהריא is retained without harmonizing the place. The full Rav titles and question direction are explicit.
